sections.Profile:
"Roto Pool," designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, is an iconic 1958 pinball machine from D. Gottlieb & Co. This electro-mechanical game features a billiards theme and includes standout elements like backbox animation, where pool balls light up as players score.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Backbox Gimmick, Wood Rail, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme
